item.title: Shiniyuku Kishi, Isekai ni Hibiku Danmatsuma
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Bug System
  • 発売日: 2024-04-26
  • スコア: 6.540000000000001/10 (166 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 死に逝く騎士、異世界に響く断末魔
  • 英語名: Shiniyuku Kishi, Isekai ni Hibiku Danmatsuma

别名

  • にくにく２

あらすじ

The long-standing battle between humans and the demons was finally reaching its climax. In the moment when Ultina and the Demon King simultaneously unleashed their attacks, the world underwent a transformation at the hands of the superior races.

In an instant, the newly appeared youth of the superior races trampled over demons and humans alike, eventually even subduing the Demon King. Ultina, desperately trying to buy time to protect Rusha at least, was futile in her efforts, as Rusha was eventually discovered by the youth of the superior races.

item.title: Manakashi no Yuri wa Akaku Somaru
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Bug System
  • 発売日: 2019-11-08
  • スコア: 6.76/10 (322 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 真愛の百合は赤く染まる
  • 英語名: Manakashi no Yuri wa Akaku Somaru

别名

  • まなかし

あらすじ

After relocating to a new town, Manami becomes captivated by a classmate who, intriguingly, shares her name. She tries to keep her feelings under wraps. However, the truth finds its way out, leading to an unexpected confession:

“…..I’m into girls too.”

With their mutual sentiments revealed, the two draw closer. Yet their relationship gradually morphs into something unsettling. How far will one Manami go to match the other’s steps?

item.title: Haze Man -The Local Hero-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Bug System
  • 発売日: 2017-09-29
  • スコア: 6.94/10 (55 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ヘイズマン -THE LOCAL HERO-
  • 英語名: Haze Man -The Local Hero-

あらすじ

Every day Shoutarou does many part-time jobs just to get by. Even though he is quite skilled at hand-to-hand fighting, he doesn’t make much use of it and lives a simple life, while watched over by his childhood friend Renka. One day, he met an intelligent life form from another planet, Fara, who hailed from a planet called Perel. He risked his life to save her from a thug’s attack and his life then changed completely.

item.title: Shiniyuku Kimi, Yakata ni Mebuku Zouo
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Bug System
  • 発売日: 2016-07-29
  • スコア: 7.209999999999999/10 (503 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 死に逝く君、館に芽吹く憎悪
  • 英語名: Shiniyuku Kimi, Yakata ni Mebuku Zouo

别名

  • Shi ni Yuku Kimi

あらすじ

It happened without any warning.

In a world that was peaceful superior beings suddenly appeared.

They one-sidedly massacred humans and the world was swallowed by a whirlpool of chaos.

While our heroine Mia was shopping with her family, she also fell victim.

With her father, mother, and older sister dead, she desperately tried to escape, but before she could a different superior man appeared before her.
